## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/grid`.

### `GridServerBindingDirective`

**Selector:** `mona-grid[monaGridServerBinding]`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a loading overlay while the application requests server data. |
| `skip` | `number` | `0` | Zero-based offset of the supplied server page. External changes do not request data. |
| `total` (required) | `number` | — | Total matching server records before paging. Must be a non-negative integer. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dataStateChange` | `GridDataState` | Emitted once per user paging, sorting, or filtering action with the requested server state. |

### `GridVirtualScrollDirective`

**Selector:** `mona-grid[monaGridVirtualScroll]`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `monaGridVirtualScroll` | `Partial<VirtualScrollOptions> \| "" \| undefined` | `undefined` | Enables row virtualization on the grid. Pass a `VirtualScrollOptions` object to configure the fixed row height. |
| `scrollEndThreshold` | `number` | `5` | Distance, in rows, from the bottom of the virtualized list at which `scrollEnd` is emitted. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scrollEnd` | `void` | Emitted when the scroll position reaches the configured threshold from the bottom of the virtualized list. |

### Types

#### `GridDataState`

The paging, sorting, and filtering requested by a server-bound Grid.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` (read-only) | `readonly CompositeFilterDescriptor[]` | Applied composite filter descriptors. |
| `skip` (read-only) | `number` | Requested zero-based offset. |
| `sort` (read-only) | `readonly SortDescriptor[]` | Sort descriptors in priority order. |
| `take` (read-only) | `number` | Requested page size. |

#### `RangeFilterBound`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/query`.

A bound of a range filter. `null` leaves that end open.

```typescript
type RangeFilterBound = number | Date | string | null;
```

#### `RangeFilterDescriptor`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/query`.

`between` and `notbetween` include both bounds.

```typescript
type RangeFilterDescriptor = FieldDefinition & { operator: RangeFilterOperators; value: readonly [from: RangeFilterBound, to: RangeFilterBound]; };
```

#### `RangeFilterOperators`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/query`.

```typescript
type RangeFilterOperators = "between" | "notbetween";
```

#### `SortDescriptor`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/query`.

**Type parameters:** `TValue = unknown`

| Name | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `dir` | `SortDirection` |
| `field` | `string` |

**Methods**

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `sort(left: TValue, right: TValue): number` | Compares two values of `field` (not two rows). Return a negative number when `left` comes first in ascending order; `dir: "desc"` reverses the result. Empty values are passed in as they are. |

#### `SortDirection`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/query`.

```typescript

```
